name: zig
description: General-purpose programming language and toolchain with compile-time code execution and cross-compilation

zig.description: Zig compiler and build system with C/C++ interop, cross-compilation, and compile-time execution
zig.usage:
zig build # Build project using build.zig
zig run main.zig # Compile and run directly
zig test src/main.zig # Run unit tests
zig cc -o program main.c # Use as C compiler drop-in replacement
zig build-exe -O ReleaseFast main.zig # Optimized compilation
